column1: # Codex 534 f. 21r (Firenze 5 Dec 1690), held-out cipher transcription, made 14 Nov 2026 from crops in which ink lighter than the main hand was blanked (luminance >= 118 -> white) so the faint interline could not be read; residual blobs were not read. Lines in the upper quarter of the letter (where the interline had already been glimpsed on an unmasked crop) are EXCLUDED from the test.
# w = the clerk's w-sign. Raw sign strings; pairing done by the decoder.
